off.revoked: The link was turned off. The buyer sees a page saying the invoice is unavailable.
off.expired: The link has expired. The buyer sees a page saying the invoice is unavailable.

linkCard.regenerateWarning: The current link stops working at once. Anyone who has it will see that the invoice is unavailable.
linkCard.revokeMessage: The buyer will no longer be able to open or pay this invoice from the link. You can create a new link later.

codes.INV_NOT_DRAFT: This invoice is already issued, so its lines and amounts can no longer change.
codes.INV_NOT_ISSUED: Only an issued invoice can do that. Issue the draft first.
codes.INV_HAS_PAYMENTS: This invoice still has payments. Refund them first, then void the invoice.
codes.INV_HAS_CREDITS: This invoice has credit notes against it. Void the credit notes first, then void the invoice.
codes.INV_NOT_DELETABLE: Only a draft can be deleted. Void this invoice instead.
codes.INV_NO_RECIPIENT: The invoice has no email address or phone number for that channel. Add one with Edit details and try again.
codes.INV_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: This invoice has no active link. Create a new one from the link card.
codes.INV_OWNER_INVALID: That person is not an active member of this workspace. Pick another owner.
codes.PAY_OVERPAYMENT: That is more than the invoice still owes. Lower the amount, or confirm that you are recording a credit.
codes.PAY_FUTURE_DATE: The payment date cannot be in the future.
codes.PAY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The payment must be in the same currency as the invoice.
codes.PAY_REFUND_EXCEEDS: That is more than can still be refunded on this payment.
codes.PAY_NOT_REFUNDABLE: This entry cannot be refunded. Only a payment with something left can be.
codes.PAY_NOTHING_TO_PAY: This invoice has nothing left to pay.
codes.ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this invoice just now. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
